def monthly_transactions(transactions: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    t = transactions.assign(month=pd.to_datetime(transactions['trans_date']).dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))
    t['approved'] = t['state'].eq('approved')
    t['approved_amount'] = t['amount'].where(t['approved'], 0)
